name: PreviewMaid
description: Preview maid is a tool to help you find missing thumbnail previews in your plex library. By default it will run on a schedule at 00:00. Optionally you can have it run once and output before exiting.

variables.name: PLEX_URL
variables.description: The URL to your Plex instance

variables.name: FIND_MISSING_THUMBNAIL_PREVIEWS
variables.description: Set to true to find missing thumbnail previews.

variables.name: FIND_MISSING_VOICE_ACTIVITY
variables.description: Set to true to find missing voice activity analysis data.

variables.name: FIND_MISSING_INTRO_MARKERS
variables.description: Set to true to find missing skip intro markers (note this is slow on large libraries)

variables.name: FIND_MISSING_CREDITS_MARKERS
variables.description: Set to true to find missing skip credits markers (note this is slow on large libraries)

variables.name: FIND_MISSING_AD_MARKERS
variables.description: Set to true to find missing skip ad markers (note this is slow on large libraries)

variables.name: RUN_ONCE
variables.description: Set to true if you wish for only on run after which the container will terminate.

variables.name: RUN_TIME
variables.description: The daily time to run the job in the format HH:MM.

variables.name: SKIP_LIBRARY_TYPES
variables.description: A comma separated list of library types to skip. Options are tv,movie,photo

variables.name: SKIP_LIBRARY_NAMES
variables.description: A comma separated list of library names to skip

variables.name: DEBUG
variables.description: Set to true if you wish to enable debug logging.
